uutiset.t: Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
uutiset.s: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

uutiset.t: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
uutiset.s: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their funadamental rights.

uutiset.t: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
uutiset.s: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

uutiset.t: Ex-media executive admits saying Australian child sex abuse survivor 'looking to be raped again'
uutiset.s: The former Murdoch media executive was overheard at an event referring to the way Grace Tame was dressed.

uutiset.t: Ex-Kenyan governor jailed for 25 years over pregnant girlfriend's murder
uutiset.s: The pregnant student was murdered after leaving a hotel with a journalist she had contacted to discuss her affair with the governor.

uutiset.t: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row
uutiset.s: The Ugandan army is helping the Congolese military fight an Islamist militant group in the east of the country.

uutiset.t: Clashes mar European games as Macron condemns violence
uutiset.s: Violent clashes mar a number of European football matches on Thursday night, with French president Emmanuel Macron condemning trouble at Marseille's home game against Levski Sofia.

uutiset.t: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
uutiset.s: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

uutiset.t: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028
uutiset.s: The announcement comes a year after a military coup with its leaders promising a return to civilian rule within 12 months.

uutiset.t: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study
uutiset.s: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.

uutiset.t: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
uutiset.s: The contents of an eight-page letter by Gianni De Gennaro have been revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home.

uutiset.t: EU leaders fail to bridge budget splits as talks stall
uutiset.s: Aid for Ukraine was among the disputes as EU members hope to conclude talks by the end of the year.

uutiset.t: 'It's impossible': Spain's young people on housing ahead of Sunday's election
uutiset.s: Europe correspondent Nick Beake speaks to one couple kept apart by high rents in Valencia.

uutiset.t: Inside Saudi Arabia, Houthi attacks test kingdom's image of security
uutiset.s: Despite the strikes, markets and restaurants in Riyadh remain busy as residents express trust in the government to protect them.

uutiset.t: Leaders clash in final Spain election debate as housing dominates run-in
uutiset.s: The struggle many face in buying a home has been the biggest issue of a bitter campaign.
